consumable.rare_tracker.name: Tracker's Flask
consumable.rare_tracker.description: Rare encounters become more likely in the next biome.
consumable.rare_tracker.detailedDescript: Multiplies the chance of meeting a rare elite by 1.8 during the next expedition.
consumable.boss_ward.name: Sentinel Resin
consumable.boss_ward.description: Blunts the damage spikes of bosses during the expedition.
consumable.boss_ward.detailedDescription: Reduces damage taken from bosses by 12% during the next expedition.
consumable.relic_lens.name: Relic Lens
consumable.relic_lens.description: Improves the odds of rare, legendary and relic loot.
consumable.relic_lens.detailedDescriptio: Adds +30% weighting to higher rarities in the loot rolls of the next expedition.
consumable.ember_ward.name: Ember-Warding Salve
consumable.ember_ward.description: Smothers the embers and flames of the biome.
consumable.ember_ward.detailedDescriptio: Reduces damage taken from bosses by 10% during the next expedition and grants +20 Armor.
consumable.rune_censer.name: Rune Censer
consumable.rune_censer.description: Smokes the runes out of the dead.
consumable.rune_censer.detailedDescripti: +45% rune gain during the next expedition.
consumable.purge_draught.name: Purging Draught
consumable.purge_draught.description: For the places where the air itself is an affliction.
consumable.purge_draught.detailedDescrip: +6 to every resistance during the next expedition.
ash.beginer_tarnished_heal.description: Restores 5 HP per level (max: 250 HP). +1 use if you have felled a troll.
ash.storm_stomp.name: Storm Stomp
ash.storm_stomp.description: Slightly raises your damage and staggers the enemy on the next blow.
ash.bloody_slash.name: Bloody Slash
ash.bloody_slash.description: Spends 5% of your max HP to deal enormous damage (x2.5) and 3 Bleed.
ash.great_shield.name: Unyielding Bulwark
ash.hoarfrost_stomp.name: Hoarfrost Stomp
ash.hoarfrost_stomp.description: Strikes the ground to raise a cone of ice. Deals area damage (x1.5) and applies 5 stacks of Frostbite.
ash.starcaller_cry.name: Starcaller Cry
ash.starcaller_cry.description: You call down gravity. If the main enemy carries a status effect, it takes 30% more damage.
ash.executioners_step.name: Executioner's Step
ash.executioners_step.description: Turns the next blow into a clean execution: higher critical damage and Bleed.
ash.dragonstorm_howl.name: Dragonstorm Howl
ash.dragonstorm_howl.description: Channels Gelmir. Stronger area damage, and Burn applied on the next impact.
ash.rotveil_litany.name: Rotveil Litany
ash.rotveil_litany.description: Applies Scarlet Rot on the next blow and slightly raises your penetration.
ash.colossus_roar.name: Colossus Roar
ash.colossus_roar.description: Roots you to the ground. The next blow gains power and your Armor rises for a moment.
ash.astral_shatter.name: Astral Shatter
ash.astral_shatter.description: Turns Intelligence into area damage and briefly stuns the main enemy.
ash.rootward_vow.name: Rootward Vow
ash.rootward_vow.description: A defensive oath. Raises your Armor and heals you a little along the way.
ash.madding_toll.name: Madding Toll
ash.madding_toll.description: Turns Madness against the enemy: 6 stacks at once, just short of the trigger.
ash.briar_riposte.name: Briar Riposte
ash.briar_riposte.description: Turns your Armor into damage: one blow equal to 150% of your effective Armor.
ash.magma_eruption.name: Magma Eruption
ash.magma_eruption.description: Strikes the whole pack. Area damage equal to 80% of your Intelligence, plus Burn.
ash.sleep_pot.name: Sleep Pot
ash.sleep_pot.description: Puts the target to sleep for 2 turns. Sleep breaks on the first hit: play it to catch your breath, not to chain into it.
ash.destined_cut.name: Destined Cut
ash.destined_cut.description: Applies 6 stacks of Death Blight. At twelve, the target loses a quarter of its maximum health.
ash.golden_vow.name: Golden Vow
ash.golden_vow.description: The oath of the Order: +40% damage on your next attack, and 60 Armor restored.
blessing.grace_of_mire.name: Grace of the Mire
blessing.grace_of_mire.description: Blunts the poison and rot of the biome. Made for tainted ground.
blessing.grace_of_mire.detailedDescripti: +3 Poison Resistance, +4 Rot Resistance, +20 effective Armor during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_frost.description: Steadies the breath and limits frost procs.
blessing.grace_of_frost.detailedDescript: +5 Frost Resistance and +4 effective Vigor during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_runes.name: Grace of Runes
blessing.grace_of_runes.description: Turns every expedition into a richer harvest.
blessing.grace_of_runes.detailedDescript: +18% rune gain and +3 effective Intelligence during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_focus.name: Grace of the Black Mind
blessing.grace_of_focus.description: Steels the mind against madness and pressure.
blessing.grace_of_focus.detailedDescript: +5 Madness Resistance and +4% effective Critical Chance during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_lucidity.name: Grace of Lucidity
blessing.grace_of_lucidity.description: An answer to the Madness of the Village and the Tower.
blessing.grace_of_lucidity.detailedDescr: +8 Madness Resistance and +6% effective Armor during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_embers.name: Grace of Embers
blessing.grace_of_embers.description: For the places that never stop burning.
blessing.grace_of_embers.detailedDescrip: +30 effective Armor and +4 effective Vigor during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_purge.name: Grace of the Purge
blessing.grace_of_purge.description: The only serious answer to the scarlet bloom of Elphael.
blessing.grace_of_purge.detailedDescript: +10 Rot Resistance and +6 Poison Resistance during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_vigil.name: Grace of the Vigil
blessing.grace_of_vigil.description: Offsets the endless night of Castle Sol.
blessing.grace_of_vigil.detailedDescript: +8 effective Dexterity and +4% Critical Chance during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_sovereign.name: Grace of the Sovereign
blessing.grace_of_sovereign.description: The last breath before the Throne.
blessing.grace_of_sovereign.detailedDesc: +10% effective Vigor and +10% effective Strength during the expedition.
blessing.grace_of_avarice.name: Grace of Avarice
blessing.grace_of_avarice.detailedDescri: +35% rune gain, but -15% effective Armor during the expedition.
trait.festival.name: Bloody Festival
trait.festival.detail: The locals work themselves up: every enemy gains 8% attack each turn, with no ceiling. Long fights turn lethal.
trait.toxic_mist.name: Toxic Mist
trait.toxic_mist.detail: The air itself is poisoned: 2 stacks of Poison per turn, blunted by Poison Resistance.
trait.blood_contract.name: Blood Contract
trait.blood_contract.detail: The Manor pays its killers: +80% runes. In exchange, no healing works while you are inside.
trait.serpent_blood.name: Serpent's Blood
trait.serpent_blood.detail: Everything alive here knits itself back together: enemies recover 3% of their maximum health per turn. You have to hit faster than that.
trait.sealed_grace.name: Sealed Grace
trait.sealed_grace.detail: The Tower severs the link: no healing, from any source. Your health bar will not rise again until you leave.
trait.eternal_night.name: Eternal Night
trait.eternal_night.detail: You never see the blows coming: your dodge chance is halved.
trait.ember_field.name: Ancient Embers
trait.ember_field.detail: The ground still smoulders: 2 turns of Burn applied every turn.
trait.scarlet_bloom.name: Scarlet Bloom
trait.scarlet_bloom.detail: Spores fall without pause: 2 turns of Rot per turn. Rot Resistance stops being optional.
trait.tempest.name: Endless Tempest
trait.tempest.detail: Lightning strikes at random: 1.5% of your maximum health per turn, and it ignores Armor.
trait.ashen_veil.name: Ashen Veil
trait.ashen_veil.detail: Ash eats through the plates: your effective Armor is cut by 20%.
trait.no_retreat.name: Nowhere to Run
trait.no_retreat.detail: At the foot of the Throne there is no road behind you. Retreat is impossible, and Death Blight builds by one stack per turn.
trait.beast_offering.name: Bestial Offering
trait.beast_offering.detail: Gurranq receives no elites, but he pays: no rare encounters, and +120% loot chance.
trait.jar_luck.name: Jar Luck
trait.jar_luck.detail: The jars are hollow and full of runes: enemies have only 40% of their health, but pay four times over.
trait.gauntlet.name: Champions' Gauntlet
trait.gauntlet.detail: Four champions follow one another without pause: no healing between fights, and every step is a boss.
